posts.title: Implementing the Temporal proposal in JavaScriptCore
posts.description: Image source For the past year, I've been working on implementing the Temporal proposal for date and time handling in JavaScript, in JavaScriptCore (JSC). JavaScriptCore is the JavaScript engine that's part of the WebKit browser engine.
